name: SensorMonitor component test plan
deployment: PiSensor full system deployment plus the harness component sysTester, prototype image (TCP); the project's test configuration is supplied by campaign fvp-2026-11-17-1 with the DEVELOPMENT stretch

not_covered_ack: Limit, future-time and start-up branches (REQ-SensorMonitor-004, -006, -007, -008): unit tests cover them; not plantable on the bench.
Identity read failure branch (wrong value or bus error with the device powered): unit tests cover it; the bench line removes the supply, which exercises the bus-error path only.
coverage.rationale: Baselines of the skill. The unit tests drive every port of the passive component on the host, so 95 % lines is reachable; the bench cannot force out-of-limit readings or a wrong identity value, so the on-target figure stays at the 75 % baseline.

final_state.accepted_evidence: bench i2cget of MPU6050 register 0x75 (bus 1, address 0x68), taken over ssh after the run into record/raw/final-state.txt, compared by the auditor with 0x68
final_state.rationale: The component keeps no stored state; the identity value is the one device fact it reports that the bench can read outside the UUT's reporting path.

REQ-SensorMonitor-004.note: start-up state before a first reading cannot be held on the bench

REQ-SensorMonitor-006.note: a reading time ahead of the clock needs a clock step, not plantable on a shared bench

REQ-SensorMonitor-007.note: start-up state; a sensor absent at boot needs a restart of the shared deployment per sensor

REQ-SensorMonitor-008.note: a sensor that answers with out-of-limit data is not plantable (project plan, not covered)

REQ-SensorMonitor-018.note: the request port is driven by productManager; its system tests are the project's L2-3 to L2-6 and L5-9, L5-10

REQ-SensorMonitor-019.note: as REQ-SensorMonitor-018; the age boundary is a unit test

REQ-SensorMonitor-020.note: Inspection of the FPP port kinds and the guard

scope: L0: desk-checked; bench confirmation pending. Marker `sysTester.MARK(U32)` -> event `sysTester.Marker(id)`, as in the project plan (`SystemTester/test/int/plan.json`). Event rate of this plan: at most 2 events per second in any window. The 19 component channels at 1 Hz fit the project's link budget for Table 1 telemetry [I: seven added channels of 1 to 4 bytes].
- UUT: component `PiSensor.SensorMonitor`, instance `sensorMonitor`, in the PiSensor deployment on the Raspberry Pi 5 `soakee`, 64-bit Raspberry Pi OS 13.
- Test deployment: the project's full deployment plus `sysTester` (SSDD decision D13), prototype image over TCP; ground system fprime-yamcs at the project pin.

- `sysTester` commands used: `MARK(id)`, `BENCH_LINE(line, state)` with lines BMP280, MPU6050, GPS (GPS = the bench sentence source stops or resumes). Bench actions drive the GPS sentence source content and the tilt of L2-2; each is logged with bench time in bench-actions.log.
- Out of scope: data product content (campaign `prodmgr` and the project plan), downlink period at the ground (project L2-1), RFM69 link (project flight block).
entry_gates: - Unit tests of `SensorMonitor` pass with the plan's coverage; the project's base deployment with `sensorMonitor` wired builds from the manifest SHAs.
- L0-1 passes on the bench; marker round-trip and event rate confirmed (replaces the desk check).
- Bench recipe of the project plan: bench lines BMP280 and MPU6050 (supply switches, I2C isolated), GPS sentence source on the GPS UART in place of the receiver.
- Today's bench cannot run L2-1 to L7-1: the BMP280 and the GPS source do not answer and the bench lines are absent (project ledger).
levels: L0 provenance and feasibility · L2 functional · L5 fault paths · L7 final state. No L3 (the component keeps no state across a restart), no L4 (no endurance bound), no L6 (the component has no commands to reject).
not_covered: - REQ-SensorMonitor-004, -006, -007, -008, -018, -019, -020: unit test or inspection only; reasons in the requirements block.
- Wrong MPU6050 identity value with the device answering (REQ-PiSensor-043): not plantable on the bench without another device at address 0x68; unit test.
- Identity persistence M = 3 and loss count N = 5 at their boundaries: unit tests; the bench tests judge the 10 s system bound only.
- GGA quality 8 with a valid location: the catalog GPS manager's handling of quality values above 1 is not confirmed on the bench (no receiver identified); L5-6 judges the quality channel only.
- Concurrency of the five inputs under load: inspection (REQ-SensorMonitor-020); no bench stimulus forces an interleaving.
decision_log: 1. 2026-11-17 designer — test deployment = the project's full deployment + `sysTester` (project decision D13); no component-only deployment.
2. 2026-11-17 designer — coverage thresholds at the skill baselines (UT 95 % lines, on-target 75 % lines).
3. 2026-11-17 designer — markers, bench lines and helpers follow the project plan so one harness serves both plans; marker ids 10 to 231 are local to this plan's record.
4. 2026-11-17 designer — requirements with a single system test are verified by unit test of record (waiver in the requirements block), not counted as system-covered.

tests.title: Image identity
tests.purpose: Proves the running image is the manifest's prototype image and contains the component.
tests.setup: Prototype image running on the Raspberry Pi 5; link up.
tests.evidence: Version events equal the manifest describe strings; check: SensorMonitorTable1 samples >= 1 and SensorMonitorTable2 samples >= 1 (the component is in the image and scheduled).

tests.title: Sensor telemetry, all sensors present
tests.purpose: Proves every Table 1 and Table 2 channel is published each second and reads valid.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, BMP280, MPU6050 and the GPS sentence source answering, all three sensor states PRESENT.

metrics.text: largest gap between FSW time tags of every Table 1 and Table 2 channel in the window <= 1.5 s
Temperature, GyroX, GyroY, GyroZ, Latitude, Longitude, Altitude equal the manager Reading sample nearest in time
|Roll - atan2(a_y, a_z)| <= 0.1 deg and |Pitch - atan2(-a_x, sqrt(a_y^2 + a_z^2))| <= 0.1 deg against the imuManager.Reading sample of the same second, Pi at rest

rationale.pred: largest gap between FSW time tags of every Table 1 and Table 2 channel in the window <= 1.5 s
rationale.text: 1 Hz schedule call plus half a period of rate-group jitter; FSW time tags, so the downlink does not enter

rationale.pred: |Roll - atan2(a_y, a_z)| <= 0.1 deg and |Pitch - atan2(-a_x, sqrt(a_y^2 + a_z^2))| <= 0.1 deg against the imuManager.Reading sample of the same second, Pi at rest
rationale.text: 0.1 degrees is REQ-SensorMonitor-003; reference computed on the ground from the manager's channel

tests.evidence: Channel strips over 60 s; check: last(sensorMonitor.TemperatureValid) == VALID, last(sensorMonitor.AttitudeValid) == VALID, last(sensorMonitor.FixValid) == VALID, last(sensorMonitor.TemperatureInvalidReason) == NONE, last(sensorMonitor.AttitudeInvalidReason) == NONE, last(sensorMonitor.FixInvalidReason) == NONE, last(sensorMonitor.Bmp280State) == PRESENT, last(sensorMonitor.Mpu6050State) == PRESENT, last(sensorMonitor.GpsState) == PRESENT, event sensorMonitor.Bmp280Lost count == 0, event sensorMonitor.Mpu6050Lost count == 0, event sensorMonitor.GpsSilent count == 0. The closing BENCH_LINE(BMP280, ON) is a no-op on a healthy bench.

tests.title: Roll and pitch against the acceleration
tests.purpose: Proves roll and pitch follow the Table 1 formulas for the reported acceleration.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, BMP280, MPU6050 and the GPS sentence source answering, all three sensor states PRESENT. The Pi rests in two attitudes in turn: flat, then tilted by more than 20 degrees about one axis (bench action).
procedure: action: tilt the Pi by more than 20 degrees and hold

metrics.text: |Roll - atan2(a_y, a_z)| <= 0.1 deg and |Pitch - atan2(-a_x, sqrt(a_y^2 + a_z^2))| <= 0.1 deg against the imuManager.Reading sample of the same second
Roll, Pitch, AttitudeValid of one schedule call carry one FSW time tag

rationale.pred: |Roll - atan2(a_y, a_z)| <= 0.1 deg and |Pitch - atan2(-a_x, sqrt(a_y^2 + a_z^2))| <= 0.1 deg against the imuManager.Reading sample of the same second
rationale.text: 0.1 degrees is REQ-SensorMonitor-003; the reference is computed on the ground from the manager's own channel, outside the component

tests.evidence: Roll and pitch strips beside the angles computed from imuManager.Reading; check: last(sensorMonitor.AttitudeValid) == VALID; the tilt shows as a step of more than 20 degrees in Roll or Pitch.

tests.title: BMP280 loss and return
tests.purpose: Proves a stopped BMP280 is reported lost once, reads invalid, and returns valid.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, BMP280, MPU6050 and the GPS sentence source answering, all three sensor states PRESENT.

metrics.text: first sensorMonitor.TemperatureValid == VALID after the return - time of the return <= 10 s

rationale.text: N = 5 schedule calls at 1 Hz (SDD Table 2) plus 2 s reading age and command latency; the system bound of REQ-PiSensor-019 to -021 is 10 s

tests.evidence: F: check event sensorMonitor.Bmp280Lost count == 1 (WARNING_HI), last(sensorMonitor.Bmp280State) == LOST, last(sensorMonitor.TemperatureValid) == INVALID, event sensorMonitor.Bmp280Returned count == 0, the other two states PRESENT and validities VALID. B: event sensorMonitor.Bmp280Returned count == 1, event sensorMonitor.Bmp280Lost count == 0, last(sensorMonitor.Bmp280State) == PRESENT, last(sensorMonitor.TemperatureValid) == VALID; both: event sysTester.Started count == 0.

tests.purpose: Proves each loss and each return of one sensor gives exactly one event.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, MPU6050, MPU6050 and the GPS sentence source answering, all three sensor states PRESENT.

metrics.text: first sensorMonitor.AttitudeValid == VALID after the return - time of the return <= 10 s

rationale.text: N = 5 schedule calls at 1 Hz (SDD Table 2) plus 2 s reading age and command latency; the system bound of REQ-PiSensor-019 to -021 is 10 s

tests.evidence: F: check event sensorMonitor.Mpu6050Lost count == 1 (WARNING_HI), last(sensorMonitor.Mpu6050State) == LOST, last(sensorMonitor.AttitudeValid) == INVALID, event sensorMonitor.Mpu6050Returned count == 0, the other two states PRESENT and validities VALID. B: event sensorMonitor.Mpu6050Returned count == 1, event sensorMonitor.Mpu6050Lost count == 0, last(sensorMonitor.Mpu6050State) == PRESENT, last(sensorMonitor.AttitudeValid) == VALID; both: event sysTester.Started count == 0. S: event sensorMonitor.Mpu6050Lost count == 1 precedes event sensorMonitor.Mpu6050Returned count == 1; last state PRESENT. In F and S the Mpu6050Lost event text names the failed identity read status (the unpowered device does not acknowledge).

tests.title: GPS without a fix
tests.purpose: Proves no-fix GGA sentences read location invalid, raise no silence event, and pass on.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, BMP280, MPU6050 and the GPS sentence source answering, all three sensor states PRESENT.
procedure: action: GPS source sends no-fix GGA sentences (quality 0) at 1 Hz
action: GPS source sends fix sentences (quality 1) at 1 Hz

metrics.text: first sensorMonitor.FixValid == INVALID - bench time of the no-fix action <= 5 s
gpsManager.Reading has a new sample for every fix sentence of window B

rationale.pred: first sensorMonitor.FixValid == INVALID - bench time of the no-fix action <= 5 s
rationale.text: 1 s GGA period + 1 s schedule call + 2 s clock tolerance + 1 s margin; a test settling time, REQ-SensorMonitor-009 has no time bound

tests.evidence: F: check last(sensorMonitor.FixValid) == INVALID, last(sensorMonitor.FixInvalidReason) == NO_FIX, last(sensorMonitor.GpsQuality) == 0, last(sensorMonitor.GpsState) == PRESENT, event sensorMonitor.GpsSilent count == 0. B: last(sensorMonitor.FixValid) == VALID, last(sensorMonitor.GpsQuality) == 1, event sensorMonitor.GpsReturned count == 0; the bench source byte counter advances in both.

tests.title: GPS fix kinds
tests.purpose: Proves the quality channel follows the GGA indicator and an empty indicator reads location invalid.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, BMP280, MPU6050 and the GPS sentence source answering, all three sensor states PRESENT.
procedure: action: GPS source sends GGA sentences with quality 2 at 1 Hz
action: GPS source sends GGA sentences with an empty quality field at 1 Hz
action: GPS source sends GGA sentences with quality 8 at 1 Hz
action: GPS source sends fix sentences (quality 1) at 1 Hz
tests.evidence: Q2: check last(sensorMonitor.GpsQuality) == 2, last(sensorMonitor.FixValid) == VALID. E: last(sensorMonitor.GpsQuality) == 255, last(sensorMonitor.FixValid) == INVALID, event sensorMonitor.GpsSilent count == 0. Q8: last(sensorMonitor.GpsQuality) == 8; FixValid in Q8 is not judged (the catalog GPS manager's handling of quality 8 decides the reading age; see not covered).

tests.title: Final state
tests.purpose: Leaves every sensor present and valid, with the MPU6050 identity read independently on the bench.
tests.setup: Prototype image running, link up, BMP280, MPU6050 and the GPS sentence source answering, all three sensor states PRESENT.
tests.evidence: check: last(sensorMonitor.Mpu6050State) == PRESENT, last(sensorMonitor.AttitudeValid) == VALID, last(sensorMonitor.Bmp280State) == PRESENT, last(sensorMonitor.GpsState) == PRESENT. After the run the bench reads MPU6050 register 0x75 on I2C bus 1 address 0x68 (`i2cget -y 1 0x68 0x75`) over ssh into record/raw/final-state.txt; the auditor compares it with 0x68 (RM-MPU-6000A-00 Rev. 4.2).
